messages:
Zoe: hey all, Zoe here (first day)! Quick: where's the right place to post laptop/setup issues, noisy CI failures, product ideas, and small UX asks? Also got a bunch of app DMs on joining  how to mute without losing pages?

Ravi: welcome Zoe! TL;DR: laptop/setup -> #help (screenshot + OS), CI noise -> #build-failures (mute this channel), product ideas -> #product-feedback or your squad channel, UX -> #design. For paging keep @oncall in your keywords.

IT-Bot: Welcome Zoe! Run: `rwi-setup && rwi-auth login`. Reply "done" when complete.

Zoe: ran it, got `permission denied /var/run/docker.sock`. who do I ping?

Sam: open a post in #help and tag @infra; paste one-line error and hostname. If blocking, start with [BLOCKING]. DMs okay for quick unblocks but tickets are better for searches.

Product: regarding product ideas, short pattern: 1-sentence problem + proposed outcome + one link (issue/RFC). Post in #product-feedback for cross-team visibility.

eng-sre: for bots: go to Apps -> select bot -> disable direct messages, or channel header -> Notifications -> Mentions & keywords. Add "@oncall" to notification keywords so pages still break through.

Zoe: sweet. last Q: when to use @channel vs @here vs user groups? timezone-aware rule?

Ravi: rules we follow: @channel = rare, big announcements only; @here = time-sensitive for people currently active (use sparingly); user groups = only after checking with owners. If unsure, DM a lead.

Zoe: awesome, posting intros in #introductions and a 1-line in my squad. thanks everyone! :wave:
